text:
The negra grinds his grain.
grinds his grain the negra.
grinds that grinds his grain
in the pilón of madera.


The negra grinds his grain.
The negra, that is mansa bestia.
The negra grinds his grain
in the pilón of madera.


and mientras that grinds the grain
their blancos dientes enseña.
The negra grinds his grain
in the pilón of madera.


The negra grinds his grain.
grinds his grain the negra.
the sol him toca the bronces
that for the brazos is templan.


The negra grinds his grain
in the pilón of madera.
the grain -grain molido-
is torna blanca belleza.


The negra grinds his grain
in the pilón of madera.
and mueve negros and blancos
in cruda luz that marea.


is his alegría salvaje
cuando it blanco the llena,
cuando is the blanco the that toma
his ardiente masa of negra.


The negra grinds his grain.
The negra, that is mansa bestia.
The negra grinds his grain
in the pilón of madera.

translation.title: The Black grinds his grain
